references.text: Describes a time of great tribulation, like the one Jesus mentions in Matthew 24:22, where it is also spoken of as a period that must be shortened for the sake of the elect.
Refers to a day of darkness and not light, which can be associated with the great tribulation Jesus speaks about.
The Revelation of John contains descriptions of the end-time tribulations, which can be seen in connection with the tribulation Jesus describes.
Speaks of sparing the elect in the end times, which resonates with the idea that days must be shortened for their sake.
Marks the elect to protect them during tribulations, parallel to the concept that days are shortened for their sake.
